notes: Pinball audio fix: audible left and right flipper presses and returns on touch and keyboard, with balanced sounds for bumpers, rails, targets, ramps, portals, launches, saves, tilt and game over. All 24 pinball sound presets respect mute and effects volume. The private pinball mixer is isolated from other games; their bundled assets and non-pinball logic are unchanged. Saved games, rooms, scores and profiles are retained.
